basis: Figure 31 'Schematic mass and energy balance for the heat supply via hydrogen conversion in a fuel cell system' (p.85, the SOFC block) together with Tab. 55 'Specifications for a 125-kWel SOFC fuel cell system' (p.84); per 1 MJ of heat
allocation: Allocated by exergy between heat and electricity, as the dataset name says; the numerical exergy allocation factor is NOT given in this excerpt.

items.name: hydrogen supply, by pipeline
items.per: per MJ of residential heat from the SOFC
items.note: Figure 31: the hydrogen input is '1 MJ / 120 MJ/kg / thermal eff. * allocation factor'. With the 33.0 % heat conversion efficiency of Tab. 55 the unallocated need is 1/120/0.33 = 2.525E-2 kg H2 per MJ heat. The EXERGY ALLOCATION FACTOR is not in this excerpt (the SOFC counterpart of Tab. 50 is missing), so the point estimate assumes a heat share of about 10 % (33 % thermal against 47 % electrical efficiency, low-grade residential heat) and the bounds span a heat share of 5 % to 100 %.

items.name: fuel cell production, stack solid oxide, 125kW electrical, future
items.per: per MJ of residential heat from the SOFC
items.note: Figure 31: '1/(Power [kW] * Annual op. [hours] * lifetime [years] * 3.6 [MJ/kWh]) * allocation factor'. With Tab. 55: 125 kWel, 4'100 h/a, 20 a -> 1/(125*4100*20*3.6) = 2.71E-8 unit per MJ before allocation. Same unknown exergy allocation factor.

items.name: maintenance, solid oxide fuel cell 125kW electrical, future
items.per: per MJ of residential heat from the SOFC
items.note: Same formula as the stack, per Figure 31.

items.name: Water
items.quote: using fuel cell SOFC,                        1 MJ/120 MJ/thermal eff. * 9 kg
items.per: per MJ of residential heat from the SOFC
items.note: Figure 31, blue (biosphere) number: '1 MJ/120 MJ/thermal eff. * 9 kg' = 2.525E-2 kg H2 x 9 kg water per kg H2 = 0.227 kg water vapour to air. The figure prints no allocation factor on this flow although the hydrogen input carries one, so this value may be inconsistent with the allocated hydrogen input above.

gaps: The exergy allocation factor between heat and electricity is not in the excerpt - only the PEM counterpart (Tab. 50/51) exists, on pages outside this range. Every allocated amount is therefore a range, not a value.

The hydrogen storage and use LOSSES - Figure 31's second hydrogen line '((1+storage loss)*(1+use loss)-1)*hydrogen input' - cannot be quantified: the loss rates are in Tab. 7 (p.26), outside this excerpt.
The 'Hydrogen (to air)' emission is labelled only 'losses', with no number.
The high-pressure hydrogen storage tank (2.08e-4 unit per kg of hydrogen) applies only 'If delivery by truck'; this dataset is distributed by PIPELINE, so it is deliberately left out.
Which hydrogen supply dataset to draw (PEM electrolysis with Moroccan solar+wind electricity) is named in the dataset title but the excerpt gives no inventory for it.
'others' in Figure 31 is an unlabelled input box with no content.
